vibe: Fresh, vibrant, high-contrast, fashion-credible but not snobby. Think Notion meets modern high-street fashion.

global_rules.spacing: Generous (p-8 to p-24). Containers must have padding to prevent text collision.
global_rules.borders_and_shadows: Neo-brutalist. 1px to 2px solid dark borders (border-ink). Hard, unblurred shadows for cards and buttons (e.g., shadow-[4px_4px_0px_oklch(0.15_0_0)]).
global_rules.corner_radius: Subtle. rounded-lg or rounded-xl, never fully pill-shaped except for small badges.
global_rules.animations: Snappy, spring-based micro-interactions. Hover states should translate elements slightly (-translate-y-1, translate-x-1) to reveal the hard shadow underneath.

colors.primary_description: Vibrant Orange - For primary CTAs and high-priority alerts.
colors.secondary_description: Electric Blue - For secondary actions, highlights, and the 'In Stock' badge.
colors.tertiary_description: Acid Lime - For decorative elements, tickers, and the live counter.
colors.background_description: Warm Off-White/Cream - The main background of the site, preventing clinical sterility.
colors.surface_description: Pure White - For cards and form inputs to pop against the cream background.
colors.text_main_description: Ink Black - High contrast for all typography.
colors.text_muted_description: Charcoal - For secondary text and placeholders.

typography.heading_strategy: Bold, tight tracking (tracking-tight), expressive. Use for all H1-H3. The logo wordmark 'restocking' should be this font, extra bold, slightly italicized with a vibrant dot or graphic asterisk.
typography.body_strategy: Clean, highly legible, modern geometric feel. Used for paragraphs, UI elements, and data points.

scales.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-extrabold leading-none tracking-tighter

routing.i18n: Implement a bilingual toggle (FR/EN) in the header navigation. Default to FR.

Header.design: Sticky, glassmorphism or solid cream with a 1px bottom border. Stylized wordmark logo on the left. Navigation links center (hidden on mobile). FR/EN switcher and secondary CTA on the right.

Home.hero: Two-column asymmetric layout. Left: Massive H1, 'Tu rates les restocks dans ta taille'. Email waitlist form + primary CTA. Below CTA: Live counter 'X personnes déjà inscrites' with a pulsing green dot. Right: Floating mock product card (Manteau oversize en laine) intersecting with a phone notification mockup.
Home.social_proof: Reddit quotes scrolling in a marquee. High-contrast stylized cards.

How_It_Works.layout: Bento Grid (Tetris Mode). 3 massive cards. Card 1: 'Colle l'URL' (Graphic of an input field). Card 2: 'Choisis ta taille' (Graphic of a dropdown with sizes XS, S, M, L). Card 3: 'Reçois l'alerte' (Graphic of a ping/notification bubble). Use vibrant background colors for each card (Orange, Blue, Lime) with black borders.

Retailers.layout: Minimalist header followed by a dense, brutalist grid (grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4). Each cell is a white square with a 1px black border, containing the brand name in large typography or pure black logo (Zara, COS, Aritzia, Uniqlo, Sézane, Mango, Arket, ASOS). Hovering over a cell inverts the colors (black background, white text).

Pricing.layout: Toggle switch at the top (Monthly/Annual). Side-by-side cards (Free vs Pro). Pro card is visually elevated with a hard shadow, an electric blue border, and a 'Popular' badge rotated at -5deg. Clear feature list with checkmarks.

FAQ.layout: Narrow centralized column (max-w-2xl). Shadcn Accordion customized with neo-brutalist styling (borders between items, bold typography for questions, slightly tinted background on hover).

Manifesto.layout: Editorial layout. Large serif/display typography taking up the whole screen. 'Because the web has enough sold out signs...' Heavy text, generous margins. Uses the 'restocked_stamp' image as a floating graphical asset over the text.

ui_motifs.stamp: Use the 'restocked_stamp' graphic rotated randomly on image corners.
ui_motifs.ticker: A continuous CSS marquee at the footer or below the hero displaying 'RESTOCKED • ZARA Manteau S • RESTOCKED • COS T-Shirt L • RESTOCKED'.
ui_motifs.buttons: Custom shadcn button: border-2 border-black bg-primary text-black font-bold shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#000] hover:-translate-y-1 hover:translate-x-1 hover:shadow-[6px_6px_0px_#000] transition-all.

component_customization.shadcn_card: Remove default shadow. Add border-2 border-black, bg-white, and shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#000].
component_customization.shadcn_badge: bg-secondary text-white border border-black uppercase tracking-widest font-bold.

media.description: 3D Notification Bubble for How It Works (Step 3) or Hero motif
Restocked Stamp for Manifesto or floating over Product Cards
3D Shopping Bag for How It Works (Step 1) or Pricing Hero
Fashion Model Street Style - Use in Manifesto or as background in Hero
Excited person on phone - Use in Testimonials or Social Proof section

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a multi-page routing structure in Next.js (App Router). Adhere strictly to the Neo-Brutalist styling (hard black borders, solid offset shadows). Do not use soft box-shadows. Apply Bricolage Grotesque for all headings. Build the /retailers page as a dense grid. Ensure the locale switcher toggles state between FR/EN content natively or via a context. Ensure all test_ids are applied. Use the provided oklch colors mapped in your Tailwind @theme block.
